summary: @ornikar/typed-css-modules-loader preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads a Bun runtime archive (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-CJS bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, containing a shuffled string-array/opcode dispatcher (function `WV8StW` rotating a several-thousand-entry array `MmgoCP`) and mangled identifiers characteristic of obfuscator.io-style string-array obfuscation. Fetching an alternate runtime at preinstall solely to execute an opaque, obfuscated sibling script is not required by the advertised purpose of a webpack CSS-modules loader; the alternate-runtime dispatch also bypasses Node-based inspection of the executed bytes. The package is published under the `@ornikar` npm scope while its `repository`, `bugs`, and `author` fields point to the unrelated upstream `olegstepura/typed-css-modules-loader`, indicating scope impersonation of the Ornikar organization around a legitimate upstream project.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
